data.body: SESSION HANDOFF — status: NOT yet claimed/implemented. Land AFTER 0347-b2cc-e6e9-4f6b. Design decisions already recorded in the earlier comment on this ticket: manual escape hatch reusing the existing /rerun force machinery + a server-side eligibility precheck that reads the bot's current-revision LLM-Review -1 vote MESSAGE TAG from Gerrit (authoritative; contributor cannot forge). Eligible sub-reasons: llm-unavailable, review-error, scanner, indeterminate. REFUSED: finding (security property) and gate-disabled (config state). No artificial numeric retry cap (manual, bounded by sub-reason). Contributor surface: a magic Gerrit comment keyword (add comment-added to infra/gerrit/webhooks.config; proposed keyword 're-review' since 'recheck' is taken by CI). Also update CONTRIBUTING.md 2c + docs/review-policy.md. Next: rebar claim bb9b-608f-0183-4ca5 --review -> implement -> land via Gerrit.
